SELECT s.isin, s.symbol, s.quarter_end, s.promoter_pct, s.broadcast_at, m.market_cap_tier FROM shp_index s JOIN master_companies m ON m.isin = s.isin WHERE COALESCE(s.broadcast_at,'') <> '' AND substr(s.broadcast_at,1,10) <= ? AND s.quarter_end >= ? AND m.market_cap_tier = ? ORDER BY s.isin, s.quarter_end

SELECT f.file, f.period_end, f.xbrl_url, COALESCE(f.dissem_ts, f.broadcast_ts, f.filing_ts) AS known_at FROM filings f JOIN filings_isin fi ON fi.file = f.file WHERE fi.isin = ? AND COALESCE(f.dissem_ts, f.broadcast_ts, f.filing_ts) <> '' AND substr(COALESCE(f.dissem_ts, f.broadcast_ts, f.filing_ts),1,10) <= ? AND f.period_end >= ? AND f.period_end <= ? ORDER BY f.period_end DESC LIMIT 12
